paragraphs: Rabbi Gamliel bar Ilai asked before Rabbi Mana: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Shevuot chapter 5. In that matter at the end of chapter Ellu Nearot: Gamliel of the house of Rabbi Avina. At the end of Niddah chapter 3: bar Liyani. In chapter Naarah Shenitpattatah, halakhah 8: bar Anya. In that matter at the beginning of Peah chapter 1: bar Ininya; Rabbi Abba bar Kahana is there too. In Pesachim chapter 1: Inyaina recited before Rabbi Mana.
